scope: Two prospective raw-token numerical cases for the fixed Gemma3 270m checkpoint and runtime. Input declaration only: no holdout predictions, native observations, or passing result. Existing runner and arithmetic remain frozen. No natural-language, clinical, unknown-history, model-training-independence, hardware, or unrestricted qualification claim.

generator.rule: sorted final allowed IDs; xorshift32 shifts 13,17,5 masked uint32; partial Fisher-Yates indices 0..34, j=index+word()%(pool_count-index); first30 distinct; last5 cycled6; deterministic index sampling, not a statistical-uniformity claim
generator.seed_scope: Reuses the existing frozen generator and seed on a newly restricted pool. No output-driven seed choice, resampling, or replacement.

tokenizer.loading: CPU tokenizer only; local_files_only=True; use_fast=True; trust_remote_code=False; no decode or private settings

baseline_gate: Require intact full533-node baseline prediction and passing three-forward full-target comparison under the declared runner/global-provider hashes, including all18 decoder boundaries, final normalization, last-token slice, every vocabulary logit and token ID. Baseline is currently unfinished; its eventual prediction/report hashes must be bound in the holdout plan. A partial target, failed baseline, changed candidate, or missing report cannot open this gate.
prediction_rule: Regenerate this exact declaration from current tokenizer assets and pinned prior protocols before use. Compute and freeze both complete token-to-selected_token_id predictions using fresh checkpoint snapshots before ANY held-out native forward. Preserve every declared case and failure; no resampling or replacement. Any abstention blocks all held-out native acquisition.
comparison_rule: Three original hooked full forwards per case, six total only after both predictions complete. Compare all18 decoder boundaries, hidden.final, hidden.last, all262144 logits.last values, and selected_token_id. No all-internal-native-state or hardware claim. Every comparison and acquisition guard must pass for the aggregate holdout result.
replay_rule: Rebuild both predictions from fresh checkpoint snapshots before any replay forward; require exact regenerated prediction and native report agreement. Preserve failed evidence, no profile tuning against these cases.
artifact_integrity_rule: Whole-file SHA256 is recorded separately in persistent task state. This declaration is not a self-authenticating or passing experiment report.
